issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add Soroban transaction simulation pre-flight checks and Fee Bump transaction wrapper
issues.body:
`lib/soroban/transactions-with-notifications.ts` sends contract transactions directly without running pre-flight simulation to estimate CPU/RAM footprint or wrapping transactions with Fee Bump envelopes when network base fees surge.

## Why this matters
Simulating transactions prior to submission prevents user fee loss on transactions destined to fail, while Fee Bump support ensures critical operations complete during high network congestion.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add pre-flight contract simulation call (`simulateTransaction`) in `lib/soroban/transactions-with-notifications.ts`
- [ ] Estimate required Soroban resources (CPU instructions, memory bytes, read/write ledger entries)
- [ ] Implement Fee Bump transaction builder (`TransactionBuilder.buildFeeBumpTransaction`) when network base fee spikes
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying simulation error decoding and Fee Bump envelope construction

## Files to look at
- `lib/soroban/transactions-with-notifications.ts`
- `lib/soroban/transactions.ts`
- `lib/soroban/client.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Contract transactions execute pre-flight simulation and display resource estimates before wallet approval
- High-fee transactions automatically wrap with Fee Bump envelopes when base fees exceed thresholds

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build dynamic UI form generator from Soroban contract ABI specification
issues.body:
`lib/soroban/spec.ts` parses contract specifications, but does not render interactive input fields matching contract function arguments (`Symbol`, `Address`, `Vec`, `Map`, `u128`).

## Why this matters
Generating UI forms directly from contract ABI specs allows developers to interact with custom Soroban smart contracts without writing bespoke React form components.

## Tasks
- [ ] Build dynamic form generator in `lib/soroban/spec.ts` rendering appropriate input controls per Soroban ScVal type
- [ ] Add type validation and format checkers for Stellar addresses (`G...`, `C...`) and numeric range bounds
- [ ] Serialize user inputs into valid XDR `ScVal` structures for transaction building
- [ ] Write unit tests verifying form serialization for complex nested `Map` and `Vec` arguments

## Files to look at
- `lib/soroban/spec.ts`
- `components/`
- `features/soroban/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Contract ABI specifications dynamically render type-safe React input forms
- Input values serialize cleanly into Soroban `ScVal` parameters

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement WebRTC Data Channel fallback for low-latency agent telemetry streaming
issues.body:
`features/agent-telemetry/` streams metrics over WebSockets, which can experience head-of-line blocking and server bandwidth bottlenecks during high-frequency agent execution streaming.

## Why this matters
WebRTC Data Channels (unordered/unreliable mode) offer peer-to-peer low-latency streaming ideal for real-time telemetry metrics and agent step logs.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement WebRTC PeerConnection negotiator in `features/agent-telemetry/` with WebSocket fallback
- [ ] Add ICE candidate gathering and STUN/TURN server fallback configuration
- [ ] Stream high-frequency telemetry metrics over un-ordered WebRTC DataChannel
- [ ] Add unit tests for WebRTC connection state transitions and fallback switching

## Files to look at
- `features/agent-telemetry/`
- `scripts/telemetry-ws-server.mjs`

## Acceptance criteria
- Telemetry client establishes WebRTC DataChannel when available, falling back to WebSocket
- High-frequency metrics stream with reduced latency and server memory overhead

- [ ] Generate client-side vector embeddings for agent titles, categories, and descriptions
- [ ] Implement cosine similarity ranking for search queries
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying semantic search similarity scoring

## Files to look at
- `features/agent-discovery/`
- `store/searchStore.ts`
- `app/marketplace/page.tsx`

## Acceptance criteria
- Natural language search queries match semantically relevant agents even without exact keyword overlap
- Vector embedding pipeline executes efficiently in browser WebAssembly runtime

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement quadratic voting weight calculator and Sybil-resistance checks in DAO
issues.body:
`features/governance/` calculates proposal votes linearly (`1 token = 1 vote`), allowing large whale accounts to single-handedly dictate DAO proposal outcomes.

## Why this matters
Quadratic voting (`voting_power = sqrt(tokens)`) balances voting influence between large token holders and broader community members.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement quadratic voting weight calculator in `features/governance/` (`Math.sqrt(staked_balance)`)
- [ ] Add Sybil-resistance verification check (requiring verified account age or minimum transaction history)
- [ ] Render side-by-side comparison of linear vs quadratic voting tallies on proposal detail views
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying square root voting calculations and rounding edge cases

## Files to look at
- `features/governance/`
- `app/governance/`
- `lib/governance/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Governance proposal votes apply quadratic weight scaling to user token balances
- Proposal views display clear quadratic vote distribution graphs

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build Zero-Knowledge (ZK-SNARK) proof verifier for agent execution attestations
issues.body:
`features/provenance/` verifies execution proofs via Merkle trees, but lacks support for Zero-Knowledge (ZK-SNARK) proofs where an agent proves correct computation without revealing input data.

## Why this matters
ZK proofs enable confidential AI agent execution verification on public blockchains for proprietary or sensitive data.

## Tasks
- [ ] Integrate lightweight WASM ZK proof verifier (e.g. `snarkjs` / `groth16`) in `features/provenance/`
- [ ] Verify ZK proof signals, verification keys, and public input parameters client-side
- [ ] Render cryptographic verification badge and ZK proof detail inspector
- [ ] Add unit tests for valid and invalid ZK proof verification

## Files to look at
- `features/provenance/`
- `app/provenance/`
- `lib/provenance/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Frontend verifies ZK-SNARK execution proofs in browser WASM runtime
- Invalid ZK proofs display clear cryptographic verification failure notices

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build Stale-While-Revalidate (SWR) background revalidation for IPFS and RPC cache
issues.body:
`lib/cache-manager.ts` caches RPC and IPFS responses but uses static expiration, causing components to block while waiting for fresh data when a cache item expires.

## Why this matters
Stale-While-Revalidate (SWR) caching instantly serves cached data while revalidating fresh state in the background, providing instantaneous UI loads.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement SWR caching pattern in `lib/cache-manager.ts` with configurable `staleTime` and `cacheTime`
- [ ] Trigger non-blocking background fetch when stale data is served to update IndexedDB
- [ ] Notify active UI subscribers when background revalidation produces updated data
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying instant cache hits followed by background revalidation triggers

## Files to look at
- `lib/cache-manager.ts`
- `tests/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Cached marketplace and contract queries load instantly from local storage
- Background revalidation seamlessly updates UI when underlying data changes

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement Token Bucket rate-limiting middleware for Next.js App Router API routes

- [ ] Return standard `429 Too Many Requests` responses with `Retry-After` headers when limits are exceeded
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying token bucket refill logic and limit enforcement

## Files to look at
- `app/api/`
- `lib/security/`
- `middleware.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Public App Router API endpoints enforce configurable rate limits per IP/user
- Exceeding request thresholds returns HTTP 429 status with accurate retry headers

## Why this matters

- [ ] Add viewport test scenarios for mobile (375x667), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1440x900)
- [ ] Fix any cross-browser rendering or touch event discrepancies in marketplace flows
- [ ] Update `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` to run cross-browser matrix in CI

## Files to look at
- `playwright.config.ts`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts`
- `e2e/journey.spec.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Playwright suite executes cleanly across Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and mobile viewports

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add automated bundle size regression analyzer and duplicate dependency scanner
issues.body:
`package.json` contains numerous dependencies, but build pipeline lacks automated checks detecting bundle size growth or duplicate package versions shipped to the client.

## Why this matters
Proactive bundle size monitoring prevents unintentional library bloat, ensuring fast page load speeds on mobile and low-bandwidth connections.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create bundle analyzer script in `scripts/` using `@next/bundle-analyzer` or `source-map-explorer`
- [ ] Add duplicate dependency detector checking `package-lock.json` for duplicated transitive packages
- [ ] Set strict JS bundle budget limits (e.g. max 250KB initial JS per route)
- [ ] Fail CI build if a pull request introduces bundle size regressions exceeding configured budgets

## Files to look at
- `next.config.js`
- `package.json`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

## Acceptance criteria
- Build pipeline reports detailed JS bundle size breakdown per route
- Pull requests introducing bundle growth beyond budget thresholds fail CI verification
